message: This is Emergency Broadcast Station 7. Remain indoors. Await further instructions. Do not drink untreated water.
Fallout storm system moving east. Expect elevated radiation levels for the next 12 hours. Seal all exterior vents.
Military supply cache at grid reference 4-7-North. Approach with caution. Heavy contamination reported in the area.
Mayday, mayday. This is survivor group Delta. We are trapped in the basement of the old hospital. Please respond.
Radiation levels continue to rise in the northern sectors. Evacuation is no longer recommended. Shelter in place.
Trading post established at the old gas station. Bring supplies. Fair dealing guaranteed. Look for the red flag.
Large animal migration observed heading south. Likely fleeing contaminated zones. Do not approach. They may be aggressive.
Clean water source confirmed at the old well, two miles east of the river crossing. Test before drinking.
Heavy ash fall expected. Visibility will drop to near zero. Air filtration systems should be checked and replaced if needed.
This is the final scheduled broadcast from Station 7. If you can hear this, you have survived the worst. Good luck.
[LOOPED BROADCAST] Safe haven at grid 4-7-North, twenty miles. Working scrubbers. Hot food. Come in on 107.0. [REPEAT IN 6:00] Safe haven at grid 4-7-North, twenty miles. Working scrubbers. Hot food…
